title: TriShieldRAG: 3 Rings, One Blind Spot in Layered Defenses for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.23838v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds LLM answers in query-time retrieved documents, so reliability depends on what the retriever returns. PoisonedRAG (Zou et al., USENIX Security'25) showed five crafted documents mislead an undefended system in nearly 90% of cases, and that single-stage defenses give limited robustness. We propose TriShieldRAG, a three-layered framework: an Ingest Guard for document-level screening, a Retrieval Scorer for trust-aware re-ranking, and a Cross-LLM Consensus over three diverse models. We reasoned that collectively screening, re-ranking and validating retrieved evidence would give complementary protection, limiting the ability of poisoned documents to succeed through any single failure. We evaluate against non-adaptive and adaptive poisoning. translated_title: TriShieldRAG：检索增强生成分层防御中的三层防护与一个盲点
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过查询时检索到的文档来支撑大语言模型的回答，因此其可靠性取决于检索器的返回内容。PoisonedRAG（Zou等人，USENIX Security'25）展示了五份精心构造的文档在近90%的情况下能误导未受防御的系统，并且单阶段防御提供的鲁棒性有限。我们提出了TriShieldRAG，一个三层框架：用于文档级筛选的摄取守卫、用于信任感知重排序的检索评分器，以及基于三个不同模型的跨大语言模型共识。我们认为，集体筛选、重排序和验证检索证据能提供互补保护，限制毒化文档通过任何单一失败点成功的能力。我们针对非自适应和自适应毒化进行了评估。在非自适应场景下，使用完整的268万段落自然问题（NQ）语料库和原始PoisonedRAG攻击，该方法将攻击成功率从79±1.0%降低至...（摘要截断）
tldr: TriShieldRAG通过三层防御（文档筛选、信任重排序和多模型共识）显著提升RAG系统对毒化文档的鲁棒性，有效降低攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: TriShieldRAG enhances RAG robustness against poisoned documents through a three-layer defense (document screening, trust-aware re-ranking, and cross-LLM consensus), significantly reducing attack success rates.
